topic: Small-angle neutron scattering is measured on single crystals of the cubic chiral magnet MnSi (Tc = 29.5 K), with the neutron beam parallel to the applied magnetic field.

facts.text: In zero field MnSi orders as a helix of period about 190 A along the cubic <111> directions; the atomic lattice constant is 4.56 A.
facts.locator: Main text p. 2 (hierarchy of energy scales)

facts.text: In the "A phase", just below Tc and in a field of about half the field Bc2 that fully polarizes the spins, six Bragg spots appear on a regular hexagon.

With the sample rotated into many different orientations (the field always along the beam), the six spots always form a regular hexagon in the plane perpendicular to the field, whatever the orientation of the crystal axes.
At lower temperature in the same field range (the conical phase), the spots lie along the field direction instead.
Rocking scans give a magnetic mosaicity of about 1.75 degrees in the A phase, half the 3.5 degrees of the helical state, corresponding to a correlation length of at least 5500 A.

ask: Which interpretation of the A phase is consistent with all of these observations?

hypotheses.text: A lattice of skyrmion lines: three helices at 120 degrees to each other in the plane perpendicular to the field, a long-range-ordered spin crystal oriented by the field and decoupled from the atomic lattice.
hypotheses.locator: Main text pp. 3-5: multi-Q structure of three helices perpendicular to B, independent of lattice orientation
hypotheses.reason: 与全部观测一致，即原文结论。

hypotheses.text: A single helix with its wave vector perpendicular to the field (the earlier interpretation), giving one pair of spots per domain.
hypotheses.locator: Main text p. 2-3: the A phase had been believed to be a single-Q helix
hypotheses.reason: 单一螺旋每个畴只给一对斑点，而实测是规则六边形上的六个斑点。

hypotheses.text: The conical phase, with the helix wave vector along the field.
hypotheses.reason: 锥形相的斑点沿磁场方向，而 A 相的斑点在严格垂直于磁场的平面内。

hypotheses.text: A multi-Q magnetic structure locked to the atomic lattice, as in the rare-earth magnets.
hypotheses.locator: Main text p. 6: rare-earth multi-Q structures are strongly pinned to the lattice
hypotheses.reason: 被原子晶格钉住的结构会随晶轴取向改变图样，而这里的六重图样只跟随磁场。
